description: This file defines the Currency class for managing currencies, including setting default currency, adding currencies, formatting amounts, and retrieving exchange rates within the Goteo application.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A class for managing currencies, including setting defaults, adding currencies, formatting amounts, and retrieving exchange rates.

methods.name: setConverter
methods.description: Sets the Converter instance used for currency rate retrieval.

methods.name: getConverter
methods.description: Retrieves the current Converter instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setDefault
methods.description: Sets the default currency by its ID.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Returns the default currency in specified format.

methods.name: addCurrency
methods.description: Adds a new currency to the list of available currencies.

methods.name: setCurrenciesAvailable
methods.description: Replaces the list of available currencies with a new set.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Lists all currencies in array or specified format.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute of a currency by its ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all currencies with their current exchange rates.

methods.name: amountFormat
methods.description: Formats an amount according to current session currency and formatting options.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats an amount with its currency symbol.

methods.name: rate
methods.description: Retrieves the exchange rate for a given currency relative to the default.

methods.name: amount
methods.description: Converts an amount to the default currency using current rates.

methods.name: amountInverse
methods.description: Converts an amount from the default currency to another currency.
